_hinweis: Englische Uebersetzung aller 211 Textbausteine aus spieltexte.de.json. Von Claude uebersetzt am 2026-10-12; zur Freigabe durch den Auftraggeber. IDs und Platzhalter unveraendert.
intro.01: In Bruchwinkel, wishes were cast in wax. Paper gave them limits. Brass carried their power. Ceramic gave them form.
intro.02: When winter came, the keepers asked for warmth, food and time. And that their wishes should never end.
intro.03: The machine heard every word. Only the word "enough" was never spoken.
intro.04: I am attempting an emergency seal. Protect what still …
intro.05: The mold broke before the sentence could end.
intro.06: I was only supposed to secure a door.
intro.07: You were never finished. That is why the machine cannot yet tell you what you must be.
intro.08: Fine. Doors first. Then the rest.
AR01.entry.01: Here they wished for silence. Now the bells swallow every sound.
AR01.entry.02: Then let us make a start. With noise.
B01.victory.01: For the first time, the Hollow King rings without devouring anything.
B01.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B01.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR02.entry.01: This warmth was never meant to fade. Now it melts the very paths.
AR02.entry.02: Warm is good. Ground would also be good.
B02.intro.01: No one will ever freeze with me.
B02.intro.02: Let them keep their shape anyway.
B02.victory.01: Mother Drip lowers the heat. Beneath the wax, a path becomes visible.
B02.victory.02: Warmth must leave room to breathe.
B02.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B02.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR03.entry.01: Every mirror shows one truth. None shows the whole.
AR03.entry.02: One of me is quite enough for me.
B03.intro.01: I see everything you could be.
B03.victory.01: The False Sovereign lets a single reflection stand. It is allowed to be incomplete.
B03.victory.02: Not every picture has to be right.
B03.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B03.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR04.entry.01: The stores were never meant to run out. Now they are hungry themselves.
AR04.entry.02: Let us hope they do not like wax.
B04.intro.01: More. There must always be more.
B04.victory.01: The Neverfull Stalk opens its chambers. The first creatures take only what they need.
B04.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B04.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR05.entry.01: No memory was ever lost here. But no one ever came back out of them.
AR05.entry.02: Then the table of contents is missing an exit.
B05.intro.01: What I do not write down will disappear.
B05.intro.02: Write down that we are moving on.
B05.victory.01: The Marginless leaves space at the end of a page. Fleck calls it the future.
B05.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B05.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR06.entry.01: Madam Mend wanted to heal everything. Even things that never belonged together.
AR06.entry.02: I am already stitched together crookedly enough.
B06.intro.01: Hold still. I will make you whole again.
B06.intro.02: Ask me first what is broken.
B06.victory.01: Madam Mend puts down the needle and waits until someone asks her for help.
B06.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B06.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR07.entry.01: Nothing was ever meant to break again. Now every shard carries the weight of all the others.
AR07.entry.02: That sounds bad for the knees.
B07.intro.01: No piece may be missing. Ever.
B07.victory.01: The Unbroken sets down its outer shell. For the first time, it can turn around.
B07.victory.02: A gap is not an ending.
B07.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B07.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR08.entry.01: The people wanted more time. Now it no longer moves forward.
AR08.entry.02: I would like some time in which something happens.
B08.intro.01: One more moment. Just one more.
B08.intro.02: You are holding up the next one.
B08.victory.01: The Thirteenth Hour releases one stolen moment. Then another.
B08.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B08.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR09.entry.01: This light was meant to burn forever. To do so, it takes the warmth from everything else.
AR09.entry.02: A rather poor sort of heating.
B09.intro.01: If I go out, nothing remains.
B09.intro.02: Then let us share the fire.
B09.victory.01: The Cold Furnace opens its doors. Many small flames replace the single great one.
B09.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B09.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
AR10.entry.01: All wishes run together here. The machine is trying to grant every one of them at once.
AR10.entry.02: Then it probably needs a break.
B10.intro.01: When nothing moves anymore, no one can be hurt.
B10.intro.02: That is not a life. Just a very tidy box.
B10.victory.01: For the first time, the machine waits for an answer instead of forcing one.
B10.victory.02: To protect does not mean to hold tight.
B10.echo.01: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.
B10.echo.02: Then we remind it of its limit.
ending.01: You also want to protect. What makes your wish different from mine?
ending.03: Protect what wants to live. Even if something breaks along the way.
ending.04: The machine loses its boundless power. The creatures remain. For the first time, they can act differently from their wish.
ending.07: It is lying in three pieces.
defeat.first.01: The mold is done for. The ring holds. I will cast you anew.
defeat.first.02: This time with a little more footing, please.
shop.first.01: A usable remnant is far from rubbish.
shop.first.02: As long as the remnant does not bite back.
shop.first.03: Then it goes on the sign.
archive.first.01: Every creature was once a wish. If you understand its shape, you will recognize its attack.
archive.first.02: Write down where I should not be standing.
ui.title: FABELBRUCH
ui.subtitle: Wishes need limits.
ui.shop_subtitle: A usable remnant is far from rubbish.
ui.victory: A wish has its limit again.
ui.defeat: The mold is done for. The ring holds.
ui.weapon_full: All six weapon slots are taken.
ui.swap_effect: The old weapon is lost. You receive no sale proceeds.
ui.abandon_body: This run's weapons, improvements and wax shards will be lost. Discoveries and memories remain.
ui.restart_body: The current run will be discarded. You start the same district with your chosen starting weapon.
ui.quit_body: Your last safe checkpoint will be kept.
ui.profile_delete_body: All progress of {profile} will be deleted. Type the profile name to confirm.
ui.all_capped: All improvements are maxed out. Receive 20 wax shards instead.
tutorial.move: Move with {move_binding}. Your weapons attack on their own.
tutorial.dodge: Dodge with {dodge_binding}. The ring shows when you can dodge again.
tutorial.warning: Dashed coral announces an attack. Leave the marked area.
tutorial.active: Solid coral means danger. Open gaps stay safe.
tutorial.pickup: Collect wax shards for Glimm's shop. Bright memory sparks grant experience.
tutorial.level: Choose exactly one of three improvements. The fight waits for you.
tutorial.shop: Buy equipment or hold an offer for later. "Next Wave" ends the shop visit.
tutorial.merge: Two identical weapons of the same tier can be merged.
tutorial.arena: Floor hazards are announced. Decoration alone never deals damage.
tutorial.boss: A keeper changes its attacks at 66% and 33% health.
tutorial.death: Your run ends. Discoveries and secured memories remain.
tutorial.story: You can skip dialogue and reread it later in the book of memories.
